words.enDefinition: Electric current with its positive direction defined as the direction positive charge would move.

examples.en: The conventional current arrow points opposite to the electron motion in the diagram of a metal wire.
examples.zh: 金属导线图中，「约定电流」的箭头指向与电子运动相反。

examples.en: We labelled conventional current before comparing charge motion in two models of the same wire.
examples.zh: 我们先标明「约定电流」，再比较同一导线两个模型中的电荷运动。

words.enDefinition: The difference in electric potential between two points, measured in volts.

examples.en: The voltage between the labelled points is two volts in the classroom circuit diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂电路图中，两个标记点之间的「电压」为两伏。

examples.en: We compared voltage at two nodes using the same reference point in both readings.
examples.zh: 我们用同一个参考点比较两个节点的「电压」。

words.enDefinition: A measure of how much an element opposes electric current, expressed in ohms.

examples.en: The resistance is greater for the longer wire when both wires have the same thickness and material.
examples.zh: 两段导线的粗细和材料相同时，较长导线的「电阻」更大。

examples.en: We used the stated resistance to calculate the current in the low-voltage example.
examples.zh: 我们用给定的「电阻」计算低压示例中的电流。

words.enDefinition: The SI unit of electric current, equal to one coulomb per second.

examples.en: One ampere corresponds to one coulomb of charge passing a point each second in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，一「安培」对应每秒有一库仑电荷通过该点。

examples.en: The worksheet converts a fraction of an ampere into milliamperes before comparing the branch currents.
examples.zh: 练习纸把不足一「安培」的电流换算为毫安，再比较各支路电流。

words.enDefinition: The SI unit of electric potential difference, equal to one joule per coulomb.

examples.en: One volt corresponds to one joule per coulomb in the energy calculation on our worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习纸的能量计算中，一「伏特」对应每库仑一焦耳。

examples.en: The model predicts a difference of one volt between the two marked circuit nodes.
examples.zh: 模型预测两个标记电路节点之间的电位差为一「伏特」。

collocations: express a potential difference in volts

words.enDefinition: The SI unit of resistance, equal to one volt per ampere.

examples.en: One ohm is the resistance that produces one volt of drop at one ampere.
examples.zh: 一伏电压对应一安培电流时，电阻为一「欧姆」。

examples.en: The first resistor has a value of one ohm in the idealized circuit exercise.
examples.zh: 在理想化电路练习中，第一个电阻器的阻值为一「欧姆」。

words.enDefinition: Electric current that flows in one direction when nonzero, even if its magnitude changes over time.

examples.en: The direct current in the diagram keeps the same direction throughout the recorded time interval.
examples.zh: 图中的「直流」在记录时段内始终保持同一流向。

examples.en: We compared direct current from an ideal battery with current that reverses direction periodically.
examples.zh: 我们比较了理想电池提供的「直流」和周期性反向的电流。

words.enDefinition: Electric current whose direction reverses repeatedly, often in a periodic pattern.

examples.en: The alternating current reverses direction when the plotted waveform changes sign in our classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂示例的波形变号时，「交流」就反向。

examples.en: We drew the alternating current over two cycles using the supplied low-voltage model.
examples.zh: 我们根据给定的低压模型，画出两个周期内的「交流」。

words.enDefinition: A decrease in electric potential measured across an element in a stated direction.

examples.en: The voltage drop across the larger resistor is greater because both resistors carry the same current.
examples.zh: 两个电阻器通过相同电流，阻值较大的那个「电压降」更大。

examples.en: We compared the voltage drop across each resistor with the rise provided by the source.
examples.zh: 我们将各电阻器上的「电压降」与电源提供的电势升高作了比较。

words.enDefinition: The electric potential difference between the two terminals of a device or source.

examples.en: The terminal voltage of the battery model falls when it supplies more current to the load.
examples.zh: 电池模型向负载提供更大电流时，它的「端电压」下降。

examples.en: We compared terminal voltage with the ideal source voltage in the given battery equivalent model.
examples.zh: 我们比较了给定电池等效模型的「端电压」与理想源电压。

words.enDefinition: Which terminal of a device is at higher potential under the stated conditions.

examples.en: The terminal polarity marks show which side of the model battery is at the higher potential.
examples.zh: 「端子极性」标记显示模型电池哪一端的电位较高。

examples.en: We checked the terminal polarity shown in the handout before assigning signs to the voltages.
examples.zh: 我们按讲义核对「端子极性」，再给各电压确定正负号。

collocations: reverse terminal polarity in a diagram

words.enDefinition: The chosen positive and negative labels that define the sign of a voltage variable.

examples.en: The voltage reference polarity tells us which node potential is subtracted in the worksheet equation.
examples.zh: 「电压参考极性」告诉我们，在练习的方程中要减去哪一个节点的电位。

examples.en: We reversed the voltage reference polarity on paper and obtained the opposite signed value.
examples.zh: 我们在纸上把「电压参考极性」对调，得到了符号相反的数值。

words.enDefinition: The chosen direction in which a circuit current is defined as positive.

examples.en: The arrow marks the current reference direction for the middle branch of the circuit diagram.
examples.zh: 箭头标出电路图中间支路的「电流参考方向」。

examples.en: A negative result means the current flows opposite to the current reference direction in this model.
examples.zh: 结果为负，表示模型中的电流实际流向与「电流参考方向」相反。

words.enDefinition: The rate at which a circuit element transfers or converts electrical energy.

examples.en: The electrical power absorbed by the resistor equals its voltage drop multiplied by its current.
examples.zh: 电阻器吸收的「电功率」等于其电压降乘以流过它的电流。

examples.en: We calculated the electrical power transferred by each element in the idealized circuit worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们计算了理想化电路练习中各元件传递的「电功率」。

words.enDefinition: The rate at which electrical energy is converted to other forms, usually heat, in an element.

examples.en: The resistor's power dissipation increases when the worksheet assigns it a higher current at fixed resistance.
examples.zh: 练习在电阻不变时赋予电阻器更大的电流，其「功率耗散」随之增加。

examples.en: We compared power dissipation across two resistors carrying the same current in the example.
examples.zh: 我们比较了示例中流过相同电流的两个电阻器的「功率耗散」。

words.enDefinition: The convention in which the positive reference current enters the terminal labelled positive for voltage.

examples.en: The passive sign convention makes a positive power result represent energy absorbed by the element.
examples.zh: 按「无源符号约定」，功率结果为正表示元件吸收能量。

examples.en: We used the passive sign convention when labelling the resistor in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图上标注电阻器时，使用了「无源符号约定」。

words.enDefinition: A drawing showing circuit elements and their connections with conventional symbols.

examples.en: The circuit diagram shows two resistors sharing the same pair of electrical nodes in class.
examples.zh: 课堂「电路图」显示两个电阻器接在同一对电路节点之间。

examples.en: We redrew the circuit diagram without changing the connections between its labelled components.
examples.zh: 我们重画了「电路图」，同时保持标注元件之间的连接不变。

words.enDefinition: The pattern of how circuit elements are interconnected, independent of their physical arrangement.

examples.en: The circuit topology stays unchanged when the same branches are rearranged on the worksheet page.
examples.zh: 在练习纸上重新排布同样的支路时，「电路拓扑」保持不变。

examples.en: We compared the circuit topology of the two drawings before attempting any numerical calculations.
examples.zh: 在进行数值计算之前，我们先比较了两张图的「电路拓扑」。

words.enDefinition: A point or set of ideally connected points sharing the same potential in a circuit model.

examples.en: Several component terminals share one circuit node in the ideal three-branch example on the board.
examples.zh: 白板上的理想三支路示例中，几个元件端子共用一个「电路节点」。

examples.en: We marked each circuit node before writing the current equations for the textbook network.
examples.zh: 我们先标出各个「电路节点」，再写出教材电路的电流方程。

words.enDefinition: A circuit node chosen to have zero potential so other node voltages can be measured relative to it.

examples.en: The reference node is assigned zero volts in the circuit diagram on the classroom handout.
examples.zh: 课堂讲义的电路图把「参考节点」设为零伏。

examples.en: We chose one reference node and expressed all other node voltages relative to it.
examples.zh: 我们选定一个「参考节点」，其余节点电压都相对于它表示。

collocations: voltage relative to the reference node

words.enDefinition: A connection between two circuit nodes containing an element or a series path with one current.

examples.en: The upper circuit branch contains a single resistor in the drawing given to the class.
examples.zh: 提供给全班的图中，上方的「电路支路」含一个电阻器。

examples.en: We labelled each circuit branch with the current variable shown in the worksheet legend.
examples.zh: 我们用练习图例里的电流变量标注各条「电路支路」。

words.enDefinition: The current assigned to a specified branch of a circuit.

examples.en: The branch current is smaller through the larger resistor in the classroom parallel circuit.
examples.zh: 课堂并联电路中，阻值较大的电阻器所在支路的「支路电流」较小。

examples.en: We wrote each branch current with its own arrow and matched variable on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图上用各自的箭头和对应的变量标出每条「支路电流」。

words.enDefinition: The electric potential of a node measured relative to the chosen reference node.

examples.en: The node voltage is positive because the marked node is above the reference potential.
examples.zh: 标记节点的电位高于参考电位，因此「节点电压」为正。

examples.en: We found the node voltage by solving the current balance equation in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们解练习纸上的电流平衡方程，求出「节点电压」。

words.enDefinition: A path in a circuit diagram that returns to its starting node.

examples.en: We followed one closed circuit loop in the drawing and returned to the same labelled node.
examples.zh: 我们沿图中的一条「闭合回路」走一圈，回到同一标记节点。

examples.en: The closed circuit loop in the worksheet includes the source and both of the series resistors.
examples.zh: 练习图中的「闭合回路」包括电源和两个串联电阻器。

collocations: voltage changes around a closed circuit loop

words.enDefinition: A circuit path with a break through which no current flows in an ideal model.

examples.en: The open circuit carries no current even though the diagram labels a voltage across the break.
examples.zh: 虽然图中标出了断开处两端的电压，这条「开路」中没有电流。

examples.en: We compared the modelled open circuit with a complete path in the resistor exercise.
examples.zh: 我们将电阻练习中模型给出的「开路」与一条完整通路比较。

words.enDefinition: A connection with zero or very low resistance between points, idealized as having no voltage drop.

examples.en: The ideal short circuit in the simulation has zero voltage across its two marked terminals.
examples.zh: 模拟中的理想「短路」在两个标记端子之间的电压为零。

examples.en: We identified the short circuit where an ideal wire directly joined the two labelled terminals.
examples.zh: 我们看到理想导线直接连通两个标记端子，在图上识别出「短路」。

words.enDefinition: An arrangement in which elements share one path and carry the same current.

examples.en: The series connection makes the same current pass through both resistors in the simplified circuit.
examples.zh: 由于采用「串联连接」，简化电路中两个电阻器通过相同电流。

examples.en: We recognised the series connection because no other branch meets the node between the two elements.
examples.zh: 我们认出这是「串联连接」，因为两个元件之间的节点没有接入其他支路。

words.enDefinition: An arrangement in which elements are connected across the same two nodes and share the same voltage.

examples.en: The parallel connection gives both resistors the same voltage in the simplified classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 简化课堂电路图使用「并联连接」，使两个电阻器两端的电压相同。

examples.en: We identified the parallel connection by tracing which nodes both elements share on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在练习纸上追踪两个元件共有的节点，由此识别出「并联连接」。

words.enDefinition: A passive circuit component designed to provide a specified electrical resistance.

examples.en: The resistor in the example converts electrical energy to heat at the rate calculated on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 示例中的「电阻器」按练习纸计算的速率将电能转化为热。

examples.en: We labelled each resistor with its resistance value before solving the circuit on paper.
examples.zh: 我们给各个「电阻器」标出阻值，再在纸上求解电路。

words.enDefinition: A resistor designed to have a nominal resistance that is not adjusted in ordinary use.

examples.en: The fixed resistor has a single stated resistance value in the component table for the example.
examples.zh: 示例元件表中，「固定电阻器」只有一个标定阻值。

examples.en: We compared a fixed resistor with the adjustable component drawn in the next diagram.
examples.zh: 我们将「固定电阻器」与下一张图中的可调元件作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A resistor whose effective resistance can be adjusted within a specified range.

examples.en: The variable resistor symbol includes an arrow in the diagram printed for the class.
examples.zh: 发给全班的电路图中，「可变电阻器」的符号带一个箭头。

examples.en: We changed the variable resistor value in the simulator and compared the currents shown.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟器里改变「可变电阻器」的阻值，再比较所显示的电流。

words.enDefinition: An element for which voltage is proportional to current under the stated conditions.

examples.en: The ohmic element produces a straight voltage versus current line through the origin in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的「欧姆元件」在电压—电流图上对应一条经过原点的直线。

examples.en: We treated the resistor as an ohmic element as long as its temperature stayed fixed.
examples.zh: 在温度保持不变的条件下，我们将该电阻器视为「欧姆元件」。

words.enDefinition: The relation that voltage across an ohmic element equals the current through it times its resistance.

examples.en: We used Ohm's law to calculate a branch current from the given voltage and resistance.
examples.zh: 我们利用「欧姆定律」根据给定电压和电阻求支路电流。

examples.en: Ohm's law gives the expected resistance from the slope of our voltage versus current graph.
examples.zh: 根据「欧姆定律」，可以从电压—电流图的斜率得到预期电阻。

words.enDefinition: The reciprocal of resistance for a resistor or a resistive path, measured in siemens.

examples.en: The branch with the smaller resistance has the larger conductance in the simplified textbook circuit.
examples.zh: 教材简化电路里，电阻较小的支路有较大的「电导」。

examples.en: We used conductance when adding the contributions of the parallel branches in the example.
examples.zh: 我们用「电导」来相加示例中各并联支路的贡献。

words.enDefinition: The resistance of a single resistor having the same terminal voltage-current relation as a resistor network.

examples.en: The equivalent resistance of the series network is the sum of its two resistor values.
examples.zh: 这个串联网络的「等效电阻」等于两个电阻器阻值之和。

examples.en: We replaced the parallel pair with its equivalent resistance before analysing the rest of the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先用并联对的「等效电阻」替换它，再分析电路图的其余部分。

words.enDefinition: The circuit rule that the algebraic sum of currents at a node is zero.

examples.en: Kirchhoff's current law gives the unknown outgoing current from the other labelled branch currents in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂上，我们用「基尔霍夫电流定律」根据其他已知支路电流求未知流出电流。

examples.en: We applied Kirchhoff's current law at the middle node of the ideal circuit on paper.
examples.zh: 我们在纸上对理想电路的中间节点应用「基尔霍夫电流定律」。

collocations: Kirchhoff's current law at a node

words.enDefinition: The lumped-circuit rule that the algebraic sum of voltage changes around a closed loop is zero.

examples.en: Kirchhoff's voltage law balances the source rise with the resistor drops in the worksheet loop.
examples.zh: 练习回路里，「基尔霍夫电压定律」使电源带来的电压升高与各电阻器的压降相抵。

examples.en: We applied Kirchhoff's voltage law after choosing a direction around the loop on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先选择沿图中回路的绕行方向，再应用「基尔霍夫电压定律」。

collocations: Kirchhoff's voltage law around a loop

words.enDefinition: A method that uses current balance to solve for unknown node voltages relative to a reference.

examples.en: Nodal analysis starts with two unknown node voltages in the idealized circuit shown in class.
examples.zh: 对于课堂所示的理想化电路，「节点电压法」以两个未知节点电压为起点。

examples.en: We used nodal analysis to rewrite the branch currents in terms of the chosen voltages.
examples.zh: 我们用「节点电压法」，把支路电流改写成用所选电压表示的式子。

collocations: solve a circuit by nodal analysis

words.enDefinition: A closed loop containing no smaller loops inside it in a planar circuit diagram.

examples.en: The circuit mesh on the left contains one source and two resistors in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习图左侧的「电路网孔」包含一个电源和两个电阻器。

examples.en: We identified each circuit mesh before assigning arrows to the independent loop currents in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先识别每个「电路网孔」，再为各独立回路电流画箭头。

words.enDefinition: An assumed loop current used to express branch currents in mesh analysis.

examples.en: The mesh current in the left loop is shown by a clockwise arrow on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习图用顺时针箭头表示左侧回路的「网孔电流」。

examples.en: We subtracted one mesh current from the other because their arrows oppose each other on the branch.
examples.zh: 两条「网孔电流」的箭头在该支路上方向相反，所以我们用一个减另一个。

words.enDefinition: A method for planar circuits that uses loop voltage equations to solve for mesh currents.

examples.en: Mesh analysis gives two equations for the connected loops in our idealized resistor network on paper.
examples.zh: 在纸上的理想化电阻网络中，「网孔电流法」为两个相连的回路给出两个方程。

examples.en: We chose mesh analysis because the circuit drawing contains only two simple meshes in class.
examples.zh: 课堂电路图只有两个简单网孔，所以我们选择了「网孔电流法」。

words.enDefinition: Two or more nodes treated together in nodal analysis when an ideal voltage source links nodes whose voltages are unknown.

examples.en: The supernode combines the two nonreference nodes joined by the ideal voltage source in the diagram.
examples.zh: 图中的「超节点」合并由理想电压源连接的两个非参考节点。

examples.en: We wrote one current balance for the supernode and one equation for the source voltage.
examples.zh: 我们为「超节点」写出一个电流平衡方程，并为电源电压另写一个方程。

words.enDefinition: A larger loop used when a current source lies on the shared branch between two meshes.

examples.en: The supermesh follows the outer boundary of both meshes in our idealized circuit drawing.
examples.zh: 在理想化电路图中，「超网孔」沿两个网孔的外边界绕行。

examples.en: We wrote a voltage equation around the supermesh and kept the separate current source relation.
examples.zh: 我们沿「超网孔」写一个电压方程，并保留单独的电流源关系式。

collocations: analyse a circuit with a supermesh

words.enDefinition: A series network that produces an output voltage equal to part of the input voltage.

examples.en: The voltage divider gives half the source voltage when the resistors are equal and unloaded.
examples.zh: 两个电阻器等值且输出未接负载时，「分压电路」给出电源电压的一半。

examples.en: We calculated the voltage divider output for two given resistances in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习中计算给定两个阻值时「分压电路」的输出。

words.enDefinition: A parallel network that splits an incoming current among branches according to their conductances in a resistive case.

examples.en: The smaller resistance receives more current in the simple current divider shown on the board.
examples.zh: 白板的简单「分流电路」中，阻值较小的支路分得较多电流。

examples.en: We applied the current divider rule to the two parallel branches of the textbook network.
examples.zh: 我们对教材网络的两条并联支路应用「分流电路」的计算规则。

words.enDefinition: A circuit whose response satisfies scaling and addition with respect to its inputs under fixed conditions.

examples.en: The linear circuit doubles its predicted current when we double the model's only source voltage.
examples.zh: 将模型唯一的电源电压加倍时，「线性电路」的预测电流也加倍。

examples.en: We checked the linear circuit assumptions before adding the separate responses in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们先核查「线性电路」的假设，再把练习中的各项响应相加。

words.enDefinition: A rule saying that a linear circuit's voltage or current response is the sum of responses to its independent sources considered separately.

examples.en: We used the superposition theorem to add the two predicted branch currents in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们用「叠加定理」将练习中的两个预测支路电流相加。

examples.en: The superposition theorem applies to voltage and current in the idealized linear circuit shown in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂所示的理想化线性电路中，「叠加定理」适用于电压和电流。

words.enDefinition: A circuit treated as a single block that connects to the rest of a system through two terminals.

examples.en: The two-terminal network has several resistors inside the box drawn on the classroom circuit diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂电路图所画方框中的「二端网络」含有几个电阻器。

examples.en: We treated the resistor combination as a two-terminal network when comparing its terminal behaviour in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们比较端口特性时把电阻组合视为一个「二端网络」。

words.enDefinition: A model of a linear two-terminal network using an ideal voltage source in series with an impedance.

examples.en: The Thevenin equivalent uses one ideal voltage source and one series resistor in the DC exercise.
examples.zh: 直流练习中的「戴维南等效电路」使用一个理想电压源和一个串联电阻器。

examples.en: We drew the Thevenin equivalent to show the behaviour seen at the two marked terminals.
examples.zh: 我们画出「戴维南等效电路」，表示从两个标记端子看到的特性。

words.enDefinition: A model of a linear two-terminal network using an ideal current source in parallel with an impedance.

examples.en: The Norton equivalent shows a current source in parallel with a resistor in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习纸上的「诺顿等效电路」有一个电流源与一个电阻器并联。

examples.en: We compared the Norton equivalent with another model that gives the same terminal behaviour in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们将「诺顿等效电路」与端口特性相同的另一种模型作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Replacing a voltage source and series impedance with an equivalent current source and parallel impedance, or the reverse.

examples.en: The source transformation leaves the voltage and current relation at the marked terminals unchanged in our model.
examples.zh: 在模型中，「电源等效变换」保持标记端子处的电压与电流关系不变。

examples.en: We performed a source transformation on paper before calculating the load current from the equivalent diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先在纸上做「电源等效变换」，再根据等效图算负载电流。

words.enDefinition: The voltage between two terminals when no external current flows between them through a load.

examples.en: The open-circuit voltage is the potential difference across the two unloaded terminals in the model.
examples.zh: 「开路电压」是模型中未接负载的两个端子之间的电位差。

examples.en: We found the open-circuit voltage from the diagram before constructing the equivalent source on paper.
examples.zh: 我们先根据电路图求「开路电压」，再在纸上构造等效电源。

words.enDefinition: The current predicted between two terminals in a circuit model when their potential difference is zero.

examples.en: In the worksheet, the short-circuit current is a calculated value from an ideal equivalent circuit.
examples.zh: 练习中的「短路电流」是根据理想等效电路算出的数值。

examples.en: We compared the short-circuit current reported by the simulator with the value on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们把模拟器报告的「短路电流」与练习纸上的数值作了比较。

collocations: short-circuit current of an equivalent circuit

words.enDefinition: A circuit model that maintains its specified terminal voltage independently of the current through it.

examples.en: The ideal voltage source maintains the same terminal voltage for both load values in our worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习中，两种负载取值下，「理想电压源」都保持相同的端电压。

examples.en: We compared the ideal voltage source with the more detailed model shown on the next page.
examples.zh: 我们将「理想电压源」与下一页所示的更详细模型作了比较。

collocations: voltage of an ideal voltage source
ideal voltage source in a circuit

words.enDefinition: A circuit model that maintains its specified current independently of the voltage across it.

examples.en: The ideal current source gives the same current through its branch at each allowed voltage in the model.
examples.zh: 在模型中，允许的各电压下，「理想电流源」都让其支路通过相同的电流。

examples.en: We included an ideal current source when sketching the equivalent circuit for the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们画练习的等效电路时，纳入了一个「理想电流源」。

collocations: output of an ideal current source

words.enDefinition: A resistance inside a source or represented in its model that affects its terminal behaviour.

examples.en: The internal resistance causes the model battery's terminal voltage to fall as its load current rises.
examples.zh: 随着负载电流增加，「内阻」使模型电池的端电压下降。

examples.en: We estimated internal resistance using the two supplied voltage and current readings in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们根据练习提供的两组电压和电流读数估算「内阻」。

collocations: model a source with internal resistance

words.enDefinition: The resistance presented by the component or network receiving power from a source.

examples.en: The load resistance determines how much current the given equivalent source supplies in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习中，「负载电阻」决定给定等效电源提供多少电流。

examples.en: We changed the load resistance in the simulation and observed a different terminal voltage.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟中改变「负载电阻」，看到端电压发生变化。

collocations: load resistance seen by a source

words.enDefinition: A rule that maximizes power delivered to a resistive load when its resistance equals the positive equivalent resistance of a DC source network.

examples.en: The maximum power transfer theorem predicts the highest load power at equal resistances in our DC model.
examples.zh: 在直流模型中，「最大功率传输定理」预测两处电阻相等时负载功率最高。

examples.en: We used the maximum power transfer theorem to interpret the peak of the simulated power curve.
examples.zh: 我们用「最大功率传输定理」解读模拟功率曲线的峰值。

collocations: apply the maximum power transfer theorem
verify the maximum power transfer theorem
resistive case of the maximum power transfer theorem

words.enDefinition: A passive component that stores energy in an electric field between separated conductors.

examples.en: The capacitor stores energy while its voltage increases in the simulated low voltage circuit.
examples.zh: 模拟低压电路中，「电容器」两端的电压增加时逐渐储存能量。

examples.en: We identified the capacitor by the two separated plates in the circuit symbol on paper.
examples.zh: 我们根据纸上电路符号中彼此分开的两片极板识别出「电容器」。

words.enDefinition: For an ideal linear capacitor, the magnitude of charge on one plate divided by the magnitude of voltage between the plates, in farads.

examples.en: The component with greater capacitance holds more charge at the same voltage in our classroom comparison.
examples.zh: 课堂比较中，电压相同时，「电容」较大的元件储存更多电荷。

examples.en: We used capacitance and the given voltage to calculate charge in the simulated component.
examples.zh: 我们用「电容」和给定电压计算模拟元件上的电荷。

words.enDefinition: A passive circuit element that stores energy in a magnetic field when current flows through it.

examples.en: The inductor stores more energy as the current rises in the worksheet's ideal model.
examples.zh: 练习中的理想模型里，电流升高时，「电感器」储存更多能量。

examples.en: We marked the current through the inductor before reading the simulated voltage trace in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先标出流过「电感器」的电流，再读模拟电压波形。

words.enDefinition: The proportionality between an ideal inductor's terminal voltage and the time derivative of its current, in henries.

examples.en: The larger inductance gives a larger voltage for the same current change rate in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中，电流变化率相同时，较大的「电感」对应较大的电压。

examples.en: We compared inductance values before calculating the response of the circuit on paper in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先比较「电感」值，再在纸上计算电路的响应。

words.enDefinition: The capacitance of one capacitor with the same terminal charge-voltage behaviour as a capacitor network.

examples.en: The equivalent capacitance of the parallel pair is the sum of its capacitances in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上的两个并联电容器，其「等效电容」是各自电容之和。

examples.en: We calculated the equivalent capacitance on paper before sketching the simplified circuit for the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在纸上算出「等效电容」，再画出练习所需的简化电路。

words.enDefinition: The inductance of one ideal inductor having the same terminal voltage-current behaviour as an inductor network.

examples.en: The equivalent inductance is the sum for the two uncoupled inductors connected in series in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，两个没有磁耦合的电感器串联时，「等效电感」是各自电感之和。

examples.en: We replaced the uncoupled inductor pair with its equivalent inductance in the simulator's circuit diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟器的电路图里，用「等效电感」替换了没有磁耦合的一对电感器。

words.enDefinition: The rule that an ideal capacitor's voltage cannot change instantaneously with finite current.

examples.en: Capacitor voltage continuity makes the initial voltage match the value just before the simulated switch changes.
examples.zh: 「电容电压连续性」使模拟开关切换后的初始电压与切换前瞬间的电压相同。

examples.en: We applied capacitor voltage continuity when comparing the two sides of the switching instant on paper.
examples.zh: 我们在纸上比较切换瞬间前后两侧时，应用了「电容电压连续性」。

words.enDefinition: The rule that an ideal inductor's current cannot change instantaneously with finite voltage.

examples.en: Inductor current continuity gives the same value immediately before and after the simulated switching instant.
examples.zh: 根据「电感电流连续性」，模拟切换瞬间前后的电流值相同。

examples.en: We used inductor current continuity to label the initial current on the worksheet graph.
examples.zh: 我们用「电感电流连续性」在练习图上标出初始电流。

words.enDefinition: A resistor with a movable contact that can provide an adjustable fraction of the voltage across it.

examples.en: The potentiometer in the circuit diagram has a movable contact between its two end terminals.
examples.zh: 电路图中的「电位器」在两个端子之间有一个可移动触点。

examples.en: We compared three simulated potentiometer positions to see how the output voltage changes in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们比较模拟「电位器」的三个位置，观察输出电压如何变化。

words.enDefinition: The terminal connected to the movable contact of a potentiometer.

examples.en: The wiper terminal is represented by the arrow touching the resistor symbol in the diagram.
examples.zh: 图中接触电阻器符号的箭头表示「滑动端子」。

examples.en: We read the potential of the wiper terminal for the midpoint setting shown in class.
examples.zh: 我们读取课堂所示中点设定下「滑动端子」的电位。

words.enDefinition: A circuit element that does not generate energy, though it may store or dissipate it.

examples.en: A passive component can store energy temporarily, as the ideal capacitor does in our example.
examples.zh: 「无源元件」可以暂时储能，示例中的理想电容器就是如此。

examples.en: We classified each passive component by whether it stores energy or dissipates it in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习要求我们按储能还是耗散能量对各个「无源元件」分类。

words.enDefinition: The response resulting from initially stored energy when the independent external inputs are zero.

examples.en: The natural response of a circuit in this worksheet comes from the capacitor's initially stored energy.
examples.zh: 练习中，「电路的自然响应」来自电容器初始储存的能量。

examples.en: We graphed the natural response of a circuit after setting its independent source to zero on paper.
examples.zh: 我们在纸上将独立电源置零后，绘出「电路的自然响应」。

collocations: find the natural response of a circuit
natural response of a circuit with a capacitor
analyse the natural response of a circuit

words.enDefinition: In a zero-state decomposition, the response of a linear circuit to a source when initial stored energy is zero.

examples.en: The forced response of a circuit in class follows the sinusoidal source after transient effects subside.
examples.zh: 课堂中，暂态效应消退后，「电路的受迫响应」随正弦电源周期变化。

examples.en: We separated the forced response of a circuit from the contribution of its initial stored energy.
examples.zh: 我们把「电路的受迫响应」与初始储能产生的响应区分开。

collocations: calculate the forced response of a circuit
forced response of a circuit to an input
analyse the forced response of a circuit

words.enDefinition: A condition in which voltages and currents are constant after transients have died away.

examples.en: The ideal capacitor carries no current once the example circuit reaches DC steady state.
examples.zh: 示例电路达到「直流稳态」后，理想电容器中没有电流。

examples.en: We calculated the inductor voltage at DC steady state from its unchanging current in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们根据恒定电流求出「直流稳态」下的电感电压。

words.enDefinition: The continuing sinusoidal response of a linear circuit to sinusoidal forcing at the same frequency after transients decay.

examples.en: The voltage and current share one frequency in the sinusoidal steady state of our ideal circuit.
examples.zh: 理想电路达到「正弦稳态」时，电压和电流具有同一频率。

examples.en: We used a phasor diagram after assuming sinusoidal steady state in the classroom problem.
examples.zh: 课堂问题中，我们假定达到「正弦稳态」，然后使用相量图。

words.enDefinition: A circuit whose relevant response is governed by resistance and capacitance.

examples.en: The RC circuit in the simulation has a resistor and a capacitor with a source.
examples.zh: 模拟中的「RC 电路」含一个电阻器、一个电容器和一个电源。

examples.en: We compared two voltage curves for the same RC circuit with different capacitance values in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们比较同一个「RC 电路」在不同电容值下的两条电压曲线。

words.enDefinition: A circuit whose relevant response is governed by resistance and inductance.

examples.en: The RL circuit in the worksheet contains a resistor in series with one ideal inductor.
examples.zh: 练习的「RL 电路」含一个电阻器与一个理想电感器串联。

examples.en: We read the current curve for the RL circuit after the simulated source changed on screen.
examples.zh: 我们在屏幕上的模拟电源发生变化后，读取「RL 电路」的电流曲线。

words.enDefinition: A circuit whose relevant response involves resistance, inductance, and capacitance.

examples.en: The RLC circuit displays a current peak at one frequency in the simulated series configuration.
examples.zh: 在模拟的串联方式下，「RLC 电路」的电流在某个频率处达到峰值。

examples.en: We identified three passive components in the RLC circuit drawn on the classroom handout.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂讲义画出的「RLC 电路」里找出三种无源元件。

words.enDefinition: The characteristic response time of a first-order resistive-capacitive circuit, equal to the relevant resistance times capacitance.

examples.en: The RC time constant is the product of the resistance and capacitance given in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 「RC 时间常数」是练习给定的电阻与电容之积。

examples.en: We compared the RC time constant of the two simulated circuits before reading their charging curves.
examples.zh: 我们先比较两个模拟电路的「RC 时间常数」，再读它们的充电曲线。

words.enDefinition: The characteristic response time of a first-order resistive-inductive circuit, equal to inductance divided by the relevant resistance.

examples.en: The RL time constant decreases when the simulation increases resistance while holding the inductance fixed.
examples.zh: 模拟保持电感不变而提高电阻时，「RL 时间常数」缩短。

examples.en: We read the RL time constant from the current curve provided on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们从课堂练习给出的电流曲线读取「RL 时间常数」。

words.enDefinition: The increase in the magnitude of charge stored on a capacitor under the stated circuit conditions.

examples.en: The capacitor charging curve rises quickly at first and then levels off in the simulated example.
examples.zh: 模拟示例的「电容器充电」曲线起初上升很快，随后趋缓。

examples.en: We compared capacitor charging in two models with the same source voltage and different resistances.
examples.zh: 两个模型具有同样的电源电压和不同的电阻，我们比较了它们的「电容器充电」过程。

words.enDefinition: The decrease in the magnitude of stored charge as a capacitor releases stored energy to a circuit.

examples.en: The capacitor discharging curve approaches zero in the ideal resistor circuit shown on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习所示理想电阻电路的「电容器放电」曲线趋近于零。

examples.en: We compared the simulated capacitor discharging curves for two resistance values during the class discussion.
examples.zh: 课堂讨论时，我们比较了两种阻值下模拟的「电容器放电」曲线。

collocations: observe capacitor discharging in a simulation

words.enDefinition: The decay of an RLC circuit's natural response due to energy dissipation, commonly from resistance.

examples.en: The worksheet shows stronger RLC damping when the simulated series resistance is increased in this example.
examples.zh: 练习示例中，模拟串联电阻增大时，「RLC 电路阻尼」增强。

examples.en: We compared RLC damping across three model curves with different resistance values in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂练习中，我们比较三个阻值不同的模型曲线所体现的「RLC 电路阻尼」。

words.enDefinition: A circuit response near the frequency where inductive and capacitive effects balance, measured through a specified response such as impedance or current.

examples.en: The electrical resonance occurs at the current peak in the simulated series circuit on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习中，模拟串联电路在电流峰值处出现「电谐振」。

examples.en: We explained electrical resonance by comparing the opposing reactances on the same frequency graph in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们通过比较同一频率图上作用相反的电抗，解释「电谐振」。

collocations: electrical resonance in an RLC circuit

words.enDefinition: The frequency at which the inductive and capacitive reactances of an ideal series RLC circuit cancel.

examples.en: The series resonant frequency occurs where the two reactance magnitudes are equal in the example graph.
examples.zh: 示例图中，两种电抗的绝对值相等时所对应的频率就是「串联谐振频率」。

examples.en: We calculated the series resonant frequency using the two energy storage components in the simulated circuit.
examples.zh: 我们根据模拟电路中两个储能元件计算「串联谐振频率」。

collocations: response near the series resonant frequency
series resonant frequency of an RLC circuit

words.enDefinition: The maximum voltage magnitude relative to the chosen zero reference in a waveform.

examples.en: The peak voltage is the height of the largest excursion from zero on our waveform diagram.
examples.zh: 「峰值电压」是波形图上偏离零值最远处的高度。

examples.en: We read the peak voltage directly from the scale for the two symmetric sine waves.
examples.zh: 我们根据刻度直接读取两个对称正弦波各自的「峰值电压」。

words.enDefinition: The difference between the waveform's highest and lowest voltage over the stated interval.

examples.en: The peak-to-peak voltage spans from the lowest trough to the highest crest on the classroom trace.
examples.zh: 在课堂示波图线上，「峰峰值电压」跨越最低波谷到最高波峰。

examples.en: We obtained the peak-to-peak voltage by subtracting the minimum reading from the maximum.
examples.zh: 我们用最高读数减最低读数，得出「峰峰值电压」。

words.enDefinition: The square root of the mean of squared voltage values over the stated interval.

examples.en: The RMS voltage of the sine wave is smaller than its peak voltage in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，正弦波的「电压有效值」小于其峰值电压。

examples.en: We compared RMS voltage and peak voltage for the simulated sinusoidal input on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们比较练习中模拟正弦输入的「电压有效值」和峰值电压。

words.enDefinition: The square root of the mean of squared current values over the stated interval.

examples.en: The RMS current gives the same resistor heating as an equal constant current in this model.
examples.zh: 这个模型中，大小等于「电流有效值」的恒定电流会产生同等的电阻发热。

examples.en: We found RMS current from the simulated periodic waveform in the classroom problem.
examples.zh: 我们从课堂问题的模拟周期波形求出「电流有效值」。

words.enDefinition: The angular offset between two sinusoidal quantities of the same frequency.

examples.en: The phase difference is visible as a horizontal separation between matching peaks on the two curves.
examples.zh: 两条曲线对应波峰之间的水平间距反映了「相位差」。

examples.en: We converted the time offset into a phase difference using the common period in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用两个信号的公共周期，把时间偏移换算为「相位差」。

collocations: phase difference between voltage and current

words.enDefinition: A complex-number representation of the amplitude and phase of a sinusoid at a fixed frequency.

examples.en: The phasor for the source voltage has a zero reference angle in our classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，电源电压的「相量」参考角为零。

examples.en: We wrote the phasor for each sinusoidal current before carrying out the complex calculation.
examples.zh: 我们先写出各正弦电流的「相量」，再进行复数运算。

words.enDefinition: A diagram showing the relative magnitudes and phase angles of phasors for a common frequency.

examples.en: The phasor diagram shows the resistor voltage pointing in the same direction as the current.
examples.zh: 「相量图」显示电阻电压的相量与电流相量方向一致。

examples.en: We sketched a phasor diagram for the two voltages using one shared phase reference.
examples.zh: 我们用同一个相位参考，画出两个电压的「相量图」。

collocations: phasor diagram for an AC circuit

words.enDefinition: A sinusoidal current whose phase is ahead of the compared voltage at the same frequency.

examples.en: The leading current reaches its peak before the voltage in the ideal capacitor trace shown.
examples.zh: 在所示理想电容器图线上，「超前电流」早于电压达到峰值。

examples.en: We labelled the leading current in the phase comparison for the simulated capacitive branch.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟电容支路的相位比较图上标出「超前电流」。

words.enDefinition: A sinusoidal current whose phase is behind the compared voltage at the same frequency.

examples.en: The lagging current reaches its peak after the voltage in the ideal inductor example.
examples.zh: 在理想电感器示例中，「滞后电流」晚于电压达到峰值。

examples.en: We identified the lagging current after comparing corresponding zero crossings on the two simulated waveforms.
examples.zh: 我们比较两条模拟波形对应的过零点，找出「滞后电流」。

words.enDefinition: The ratio of voltage phasor to current phasor for an element or network at a specified frequency.

examples.en: The impedance of the example contains both a resistance and a reactance in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂模型里，示例的「阻抗」由电阻和电抗组成。

examples.en: We calculated impedance at two frequencies to see how the circuit response changes in the simulation.
examples.zh: 我们计算两个频率下的「阻抗」，查看模拟中电路响应如何变化。

words.enDefinition: The absolute value of complex impedance, equal to voltage magnitude divided by current magnitude.

examples.en: The impedance magnitude increases in our series circuit model when the reactance magnitude becomes larger.
examples.zh: 在串联电路模型中，电抗幅值增大时，「阻抗幅值」增大。

examples.en: We used the impedance magnitude to compare current amplitudes under the same source voltage in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂上，我们借助「阻抗幅值」比较相同电源电压下的电流幅值。

words.enDefinition: The imaginary part of impedance that comes from capacitive or inductive effects in a circuit.

examples.en: The total reactance vanishes when the capacitive and inductive contributions cancel in the idealized series circuit.
examples.zh: 理想化串联电路中，容性和感性贡献相互抵消时，总「电抗」为零。

examples.en: We labelled the reactance separately from the resistance in the complex impedance calculation on paper.
examples.zh: 我们在纸上用复数计算阻抗时，分别标出「电抗」与电阻。

words.enDefinition: The positive contribution to reactance from an ideal inductor, increasing with frequency for fixed inductance.

examples.en: Inductive reactance increases as the simulated source frequency rises while inductance remains constant in class.
examples.zh: 课堂模拟中，电感保持恒定时，电源频率上升会使「感抗」增大。

examples.en: We compared inductive reactance at two frequencies given on the worksheet before calculating the current.
examples.zh: 计算电流之前，我们先比较练习给出两个频率下的「感抗」。

words.enDefinition: The contribution of an ideal capacitor to reactance, negative under the usual positive-frequency phasor convention.

examples.en: The magnitude of capacitive reactance decreases when the frequency rises in our ideal capacitor exercise.
examples.zh: 在理想电容器练习中，频率上升时，「容抗」的绝对值减小。

examples.en: We kept the sign of capacitive reactance when combining it with inductive reactance on paper.
examples.zh: 我们在纸上合并「容抗」和感抗时，保留了容抗的正负号。

words.enDefinition: The voltage-to-current phasor ratio presented at a network or instrument input at a specified frequency.

examples.en: The input impedance of the model is calculated looking into the two terminals marked in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们从标记的两个端子看入模型，计算其「输入阻抗」。

examples.en: We compared instrument input impedance with the circuit impedance in the simulated measurement example.
examples.zh: 在模拟测量示例中，我们比较仪表「输入阻抗」与电路阻抗。

words.enDefinition: The reciprocal of impedance, relating the current phasor to the voltage phasor.

examples.en: The admittance is easier to combine for the parallel branches in the example circuit diagram.
examples.zh: 示例电路图中，使用「导纳」更容易合并各条并联支路。

examples.en: We inverted the impedance to find the admittance of the idealized component in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们取阻抗的倒数，求得理想化元件的「导纳」。

words.enDefinition: The average rate at which electrical energy is transferred or converted over an AC cycle.

examples.en: The active power is positive because the resistor absorbs energy on average in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，电阻器平均吸收能量，因此「有功功率」为正。

examples.en: We calculated active power from the simulated voltage and current waveforms in the classroom problem.
examples.zh: 我们用课堂问题中的模拟电压和电流波形计算「有功功率」。

collocations: active power absorbed by a load

words.enDefinition: The imaginary part of complex power, representing alternating energy exchange in sinusoidal circuit analysis.

examples.en: The reactive power indicates reversible energy exchange in the ideal inductive example shown in class.
examples.zh: 课堂所示理想电感示例中，「无功功率」表示可逆的能量交换。

examples.en: We compared the signs of reactive power for the ideal capacitor and inductor in the simulation.
examples.zh: 在模拟中，我们比较理想电容器与电感器「无功功率」的正负号。

collocations: reactive power of an inductive element

words.enDefinition: The product of RMS voltage and RMS current, equal to the magnitude of complex power in sinusoidal analysis.

examples.en: The apparent power uses the two effective values shown beside the waveform in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂练习中的「视在功率」用波形旁显示的两个有效值计算。

examples.en: We compared apparent power with active power in the ideal resistive example on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们比较练习纸上理想电阻示例的「视在功率」与有功功率。

words.enDefinition: The ratio of active power to apparent power, equal to the cosine of the phase difference for sinusoids.

examples.en: The power factor equals one for the ideal resistive load in our sinusoidal circuit exercise.
examples.zh: 在正弦电路练习中，理想阻性负载的「功率因数」等于一。

examples.en: We calculated the power factor from the given phase angle after checking the waveform assumption.
examples.zh: 我们先核对波形假设，再根据给定相位角计算「功率因数」。

words.enDefinition: A meter with a digital display and functions for measuring quantities such as voltage, current, and resistance.

examples.en: The digital multimeter display in the handout shows a value and its unit of measurement.
examples.zh: 讲义中的「数字万用表」显示屏给出数值及其计量单位。

examples.en: We distinguished the digital multimeter from the instrument that displays a changing voltage over time.
examples.zh: 我们把「数字万用表」与能显示电压随时间变化的仪器区分开。

words.enDefinition: An instrument for measuring the potential difference between two points.

examples.en: The voltmeter symbol spans the two marked nodes in the low-voltage circuit diagram.
examples.zh: 低压电路图中的「电压表」符号跨接于两个标记节点之间。

examples.en: We compared the voltmeter reading with the calculated potential difference in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 我们把「电压表」读数与课堂练习算出的电位差作了比较。

words.enDefinition: An instrument for measuring electric current through a circuit path.

examples.en: The ammeter reading is the current through the marked branch in the ideal classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂理想模型里的「电流表」读数是标记支路的电流。

examples.en: We identified the ammeter symbol drawn in series with the resistor on the supplied diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在给定图上识别出与电阻器串联的「电流表」符号。

words.enDefinition: An instrument that measures electrical resistance using its own test stimulus.

examples.en: The ohmmeter reading is compared with the stated resistance of an isolated component in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习把「欧姆表」读数与独立元件的标定电阻作了比较。

examples.en: We matched the ohmmeter display to the disconnected resistor pictured on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们把「欧姆表」显示值与课堂练习纸上未连接的电阻器对应起来。

words.enDefinition: A change in the quantity being measured caused by the measuring instrument interacting with the circuit.

examples.en: Measurement loading lowers the voltage seen in the simulated divider because the meter draws some current.
examples.zh: 在模拟分压电路中，仪表分走一部分电流，因「测量负载效应」而使读到的电压降低。

examples.en: We used the ideal and nonideal meter models to illustrate measurement loading in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们用理想与非理想仪表模型说明练习中的「测量负载效应」。

words.enDefinition: The voltage drop introduced across a meter when current passes through its measuring path.

examples.en: The burden voltage is included as a small drop in the classroom model of an ammeter.
examples.zh: 课堂电流表模型把「负担电压」计为一小段压降。

examples.en: We compared burden voltage for two simulated instruments measuring the same small current in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们比较两台模拟仪表测量同一小电流时的「负担电压」。

words.enDefinition: An indication that the instrument detects a path with resistance below its continuity threshold.

examples.en: The continuity indicator is shown next to the reading for an intact isolated wire in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习纸中，一根与电路分离且完好的导线读数旁显示「通断指示」。

examples.en: We identified the continuity indicator in the illustrated meter display for the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习所示的仪表显示屏上识别出「通断指示」。

words.enDefinition: The interval of resistance values a meter can display using a particular measurement setting.

examples.en: The resistance range in the handout covers the nominal value of the modelled resistor.
examples.zh: 讲义列出的「电阻量程」覆盖所示电阻器的标称阻值。

examples.en: We compared the resolution shown for each resistance range in the instrument's example specification table.
examples.zh: 我们比较仪表规格示例表中各「电阻量程」所列的分辨率。

words.enDefinition: Automatic selection of a measurement range by an instrument as the measured value changes.

examples.en: Auto-ranging explains why the position of the decimal point changes between these two display examples.
examples.zh: 「自动量程切换」解释了为什么这两个显示示例的小数点位置不同。

examples.en: We compared automatic switching with a fixed setting while reading the overview of auto-ranging.
examples.zh: 阅读「自动量程切换」概述时，我们比较了自动切换与固定设置。

words.enDefinition: A display or status indicating that the measured value exceeds the selected measurement range.

examples.en: The overrange indication appears when the simulated reading is above the example instrument's selected range.
examples.zh: 模拟读数超出示例仪表选定的量程时，会显示「超量程指示」。

examples.en: We checked the legend to distinguish the overrange indication from an ordinary zero reading.
examples.zh: 我们查阅图例，区分「超量程指示」和普通的零读数。

words.enDefinition: A meter that reports the root mean square of a waveform for the selected measurement mode within specified operating limits.

examples.en: The true RMS meter measures the effective value of the non-sinusoidal trace in our worksheet example.
examples.zh: 练习纸的「真有效值仪表」测量非正弦波形的有效值。

examples.en: We compared a true RMS meter with an instrument calibrated for sine waves only.
examples.zh: 我们将「真有效值仪表」与仅按正弦波校准的仪表作了比较。

collocations: frequency limits of a true RMS meter

words.enDefinition: A known low resistance used to determine current from the voltage developed across it.

examples.en: The current shunt has a small resistance in the ideal measurement circuit drawn on the board.
examples.zh: 白板上的理想测量电路图里，「电流分流器」的电阻很小。

examples.en: We calculated current from the voltage across the current shunt in the supplied model.
examples.zh: 我们根据给定模型中「电流分流器」两端的电压计算电流。

words.enDefinition: A method that uses separate current and voltage-sensing leads to reduce the effect of test-lead resistance.

examples.en: The four-wire resistance measurement diagram has separate paths for the test current and the sensed voltage.
examples.zh: 「四线制电阻测量」图将测试电流和电压检测分别画在不同通路上。

examples.en: We compared the four-wire resistance measurement with the simpler diagram that includes lead resistance in its result.
examples.zh: 我们把「四线制电阻测量」与结果中包含引线电阻的较简方案作了比较。

collocations: four-wire resistance measurement of a low resistance

words.enDefinition: An insulated wire used to connect a measuring instrument to a test point or component.

examples.en: The test lead is shown as a thin line between the meter and the labelled point.
examples.zh: 图中，仪表与标记点之间的细线表示「测试线」。

examples.en: We identified the test lead in the photograph printed next to the example instrument display.
examples.zh: 我们在示例仪表显示屏旁印出的照片上识别出「测试线」。

words.enDefinition: A socket on a meter that accepts a test lead for a specified measurement function.

examples.en: The meter input jack has a printed label that identifies its measurement function on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习图中的「仪表输入插孔」旁印有标签，指明其测量功能。

examples.en: We matched each meter input jack to the label shown in the illustrated instrument manual.
examples.zh: 我们按图示仪器手册，把每个「仪表输入插孔」与所示标签对应起来。

words.enDefinition: An instrument that displays how electrical signals change, commonly showing voltage against time.

examples.en: The oscilloscope shows two repeating voltage traces in the low-voltage classroom simulation on the screen.
examples.zh: 屏幕上的低压课堂模拟中，「示波器」显示两条重复的电压波形。

examples.en: We used the oscilloscope screenshot to compare the shapes of the two example waveforms.
examples.zh: 我们借助「示波器」截图比较两条示例波形的形状。

words.enDefinition: The visible curve representing the measured signal on an oscilloscope display.

examples.en: The oscilloscope trace reaches its highest point near the middle of the printed screen image.
examples.zh: 印出的屏幕图像中，「示波器波形曲线」在接近中间处达到最高点。

examples.en: We compared the oscilloscope trace with the voltage values calculated for the simulated circuit.
examples.zh: 我们将「示波器波形曲线」与模拟电路的计算电压比较。

words.enDefinition: The signal value represented by each vertical division on an oscilloscope display.

examples.en: The vertical scale gives the voltage represented by each square on the printed oscilloscope grid.
examples.zh: 「垂直标度」给出印制的示波器网格上每个竖向格距对应的电压。

examples.en: We used the vertical scale to convert the height of the curve into a voltage reading.
examples.zh: 我们利用「垂直标度」，将曲线高度换算成电压读数。

collocations: vertical scale in volts per division

words.enDefinition: The oscilloscope setting or system that determines how much time each horizontal division represents.

examples.en: The timebase is shown beneath the axis in the simulated oscilloscope display used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂所用的模拟示波器图把「时基」标在坐标轴下方。

examples.en: We read the timebase before calculating the period of the waveform from the printed graph.
examples.zh: 从印制图表计算波形周期之前，我们先读取「时基」。

words.enDefinition: The signal value at which an oscilloscope edge trigger can act when the other conditions are met.

examples.en: The trigger level is marked as a horizontal dashed line on the practice waveform display.
examples.zh: 练习波形显示中，「触发电平」用一条水平虚线标出。

examples.en: We checked which part of the rising curve crosses the trigger level in the provided screenshot.
examples.zh: 我们在给定截图中查看上升曲线哪一段穿过「触发电平」。

words.enDefinition: The rising or falling direction of a waveform crossing required by an oscilloscope edge trigger.

examples.en: The trigger slope is set to rising in the classroom example displayed on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习纸展示的课堂示例将「触发斜率」设为上升。

examples.en: We matched the trigger slope to the correct crossing direction on the illustrated voltage trace.
examples.zh: 我们将「触发斜率」与电压图线对应的穿越方向匹配起来。

words.enDefinition: A fixed or selected ratio by which a probe reduces the voltage delivered to an instrument input.

examples.en: The probe attenuation is listed next to the channel setting in the illustrated measurement report.
examples.zh: 图示测量报告在通道设置旁列出「探头衰减」。

examples.en: We accounted for probe attenuation when interpreting the supplied trace and its voltage scale.
examples.zh: 解读给定轨迹线及其电压刻度时，我们计入了「探头衰减」。

words.enDefinition: An instrument input mode that passes both a signal's steady offset and its time-varying part.

examples.en: DC coupling preserves the offset between the waveform centre and the zero line in this example.
examples.zh: 「直流耦合」保留了示例中波形中心与零线之间的偏置。

examples.en: We used the screenshot labelled DC coupling to read the whole voltage relative to zero.
examples.zh: 我们从标有「直流耦合」的截图读取相对于零点的完整电压。

words.enDefinition: An instrument input mode that blocks the steady component and attenuates low-frequency content.

examples.en: AC coupling removes the steady offset so the waveform is centred differently in the classroom display.
examples.zh: 「交流耦合」去除直流偏置，因此课堂图的波形中心位置改变。

examples.en: We compared the screenshot labelled AC coupling with the image that retains the steady offset.
examples.zh: 我们将标有「交流耦合」的截图与仍含直流偏置的图像比较。

words.enDefinition: A laboratory instrument that provides adjustable power for a circuit under its stated output limits.

examples.en: The bench power supply display in the training screenshot shows separate voltage and current values.
examples.zh: 训练截图中的「台式电源」分别显示电压和电流。

examples.en: We matched the bench power supply symbol to the low-voltage source in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们将「台式电源」的符号与电路图中的低压电源对应起来。

collocations: output of a bench power supply

words.enDefinition: A supply mode in which the output voltage stays at the set value within available limits.

examples.en: The constant-voltage mode indicator is active in the first low-voltage supply screenshot shown in class.
examples.zh: 课堂展示的第一张低压电源截图中，「恒压模式」指示亮起。

examples.en: We used constant-voltage mode to explain why the model output voltage stayed fixed in the example.
examples.zh: 我们用「恒压模式」解释为什么示例中模型的输出电压保持不变。

words.enDefinition: A supply mode in which the output current stays at the set value within available limits.

examples.en: The constant-current mode indicator appears when the simulated supply holds its output at the selected current.
examples.zh: 模拟电源将输出保持在设定电流时，会出现「恒流模式」指示。

examples.en: We compared constant-current mode with the model that holds its output voltage fixed in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们比较了「恒流模式」与维持输出电压恒定的模型。

words.enDefinition: The maximum output current a supply is configured to allow in a stated operating mode.

examples.en: The current limit is shown beneath the voltage setting in the low-voltage simulation display.
examples.zh: 在低压模拟界面上，「电流限值」显示在电压设定下方。

examples.en: We read the current limit from the provided screenshot before interpreting the change in supply mode.
examples.zh: 我们先从给定截图读取「电流限值」，再解释电源模式的变化。

words.enDefinition: A reusable board with groups of connected contacts that can hold components without soldering.

examples.en: The solderless breadboard diagram uses shading to show which holes share the same electrical connection.
examples.zh: 「免焊面包板」图用阴影显示哪些孔彼此电气相通。

examples.en: We compared the solderless breadboard drawing with the symbolic low-voltage circuit diagram on paper.
examples.zh: 我们在纸上将「免焊面包板」示意图与低压电路符号图作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A set of coloured bands indicating a resistor's nominal value and usually its tolerance.

examples.en: The resistor colour code in the example matches the nominal value printed beside the drawing.
examples.zh: 示例中的「电阻色环码」与图旁印出的标称阻值相符。

examples.en: We used the resistor colour code chart to interpret the illustrated bands in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 我们用「电阻色环码」表解读课堂练习中所画的各条色环。
